posts.title: Premium Midwit
posts.description: Top twenty on the November 2026 chess list: all men. Hou Yifan is 161st, 123 Elo back. A real gap. Not an order of magnitude, and not a theory of women.

posts.title: Meat Filter
posts.description: The first gate to an engineering job is someone reading questions they don't understand off a 2015 script. Not an interview. A meat filter.

posts.title: Less in the Way
posts.description: Specialized knowledge pays for a few more years, then depreciates to zero. What's left is adaptive intelligence that slows the machine least.
